_source: pano-scrobbler RegexPresets.kt. Regex presets apply replace-first per listed field, case-insensitively. Order matters and mirrors pano's enum order; the parse_title presets are implemented in code (see internal/clean/presets.go), gated on hosts youtube.com / music.youtube.com. hosts, when present, limits a preset to those URL hosts.

presets.name: remastered
presets._note: diverges from upstream: when the remaster suffix is dash/slash-separated inside brackets ('1999 (7" Stereo Edit - 2019 Remaster)'), the closing bracket belongs to group 1 and is restored via $2 instead of being swallowed

presets.name: explicit
presets._note: diverges from upstream like 'remastered': a dash/slash-separated suffix inside brackets keeps its closing bracket via $2

presets.name: album_ver
presets._note: diverges from upstream like 'remastered': a dash/slash-separated suffix inside brackets keeps its closing bracket via $2. Also diverges by accepting a slash-joined qualifier after album ('Album/EP Version', 'Album/Single Version')
